about_intro: Tradishion is an intercultural and intergenerational initiative built to protect, transmit, and celebrate traditional fashion heritage.
about_s1_desc: We aim to connect people who carry unique know-how with those who want to learn and preserve these traditions for the future.
about_s2_desc: We believe traditional clothing is a living memory that must be protected and passed on. In a world shaped by westernization and rapid modernization, many cultural practices risk being overlooked, simplified, or forgotten. Through shared stories, techniques, and practices, we aim to keep this heritage visible, valued, and accessible to younger generations across communities worldwide.
about_s3_li1: A social network focused on traditional fashion culture.
about_s3_li2: An explorer space to discover profiles and shared experiences.
about_s3_li3: A messaging and events ecosystem to create meaningful connections.
about_s3_li4: An event platform to organize and promote traditional fashion activities between communities.
about_s4_desc1: Tradishion was developed by an international student team as part of the International Open Bidding Project (IOBC) 2026, in collaboration across several universities.
about_s4_desc2: This team is composed of french, albanian and vietnamese students, specialized in various multimedia domains.
about_s4_desc3: We got Fahed Ismaili Alaoui, Raphael Piechocki, Kaina Slimani and Mai Hoàng Đức as developers, Sarah Ould Mohammed and Steve Kpatinde as graphic designers and audiovisual artists, and finally Amaury Fabre and Kylian Giard Ouadifi as communication strategists.
about_s5_desc: Respect, curiosity, inclusion, and cultural transmission guide every part of the platform and community behavior.
cgu_intro2: Tradishion is a cross-generational platform created by Tradishion Corp, dedicated to sharing skills, experiences, and life histories related to traditional fashion around the world.
cgu_intro3: By ticking the acceptance box before subscribing to the platform, you officially agree to the following User Agreement and Terms of Service.
cgu_s1_desc: Tradishion aims to bridge the gap between different generations and cultures by allowing users to find others based on mutual interests, get in contact, and organize online meetings. Access to the private section of this network is strictly reserved for users who have subscribed to the platform and explicitly agreed to these legal conditions.
cgu_s2_desc: To use the private features, such as the internal messaging system, the user database, and the personal agenda, you must create an account. You agree to provide accurate information regarding the languages you speak, your geographical location, and the traditional fashion experiences you wish to share.
cgu_s3_title: 3. Code of Conduct and Good Practices
cgu_s3_desc1: Tradishion is a space for cultural celebration and respectful cross-generational exchange. As a user, you agree that all discussions and contents you share must strictly comply with your country's regulations.
cgu_s3_desc2: Furthermore, users must adhere to our strict rules of good practice. Tradishion enforces a zero-tolerance policy regarding the following:
cgu_s3_li1: • Calling for hate, violence, or murder.
cgu_s3_li2: • Expressing racist, xenophobic, or sexist views.
cgu_s3_li3: • Harassment, bullying, or abusive behavior toward any other user.
cgu_s3_li4: • Disrespecting the cultural heritage or traditional attire shared by others.
cgu_s4_desc: Our platform provides an internal messaging system allowing you to exchange messages without needing to disclose your e-mail address initially. The delivery of messages is submitted to social networking constraints (e.g., connection requests must be accepted to fully communicate). Users are responsible for their behavior during online meetings and text chats.
cgu_s5_desc: Users retain ownership of the personal content they share on Tradishion (texts, photos of traditional clothing, videos of sewing skills, etc.). However, by posting content publicly or sharing it within the network, you grant Tradishion Corp the right to display it within the platform's ecosystem. You must ensure you have the rights to any image or video you upload.
cgu_s6_desc: Tradishion Corp reserves the right to moderate public and shared events. If a user violates these Terms of Service, especially the Code of Conduct, we reserve the right to immediately suspend or permanently delete their account without prior notice.
contact_intro: Need help, want to report an issue, or have ideas for Tradishion? Reach out to our team.
contact_s1_time: Response time: We usually answer within 2 to 5 business days.
contact_s2_desc: If you experience a bug or access issue, include the following details in your message:
contact_s2_li2: • The page where the issue happened.
contact_s2_li3: • A short description of what happened.
contact_s3_desc: For any request related to your personal data (access, correction, deletion), contact the team and specify your request clearly.
contact_s4_desc: Tradishion is an educational prototype developed in an academic environment within the IOBC 2026 project.

priv_s1_desc: Welcome to the privacy policy of the Tradishion platform. This document explains how Tradishion Corp collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
priv_s2_desc: The data controller for this platform is the Tradishion Corp team.
priv_s3_desc: To allow you to use the private section of our network, we collect the following personal information:
priv_s3_li1: Account Credentials: Your e-mail address and password.
priv_s3_li2: Profile Information: The languages you speak, your geographical location, and experiences.
priv_s3_li3: Interaction Data: Data related to your connections, agenda, and internal messages.
priv_s4_title: 4. How Do We Use Your Data?
priv_s4_desc: We use your data exclusively to operate the Tradishion platform:
priv_s4_li2: Communication: Your e-mail address is kept strictly confidential.
priv_s5_desc: Your personal data is stored securely on our academic hosting environment (LAMP server) using MariaDB and PHP.
priv_s6_li1: Public Section: No personal data is required for access.
priv_s6_li2: Private Section: Profile info is only visible to other registered users.
priv_s6_li3: Agenda Privacy: Private events appear only as blocked slots to others.
priv_s7_desc1: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
priv_s7_li1: • Access, Rectify, or Erase your data.
priv_s7_li2: • Restrict or Object to the processing of your data.
priv_s7_desc2: To exercise these rights, please contact the team through the internal messaging system.
